capabilities: Generate quizzes from notes, selected text, or manual entry, with AI providers or without
Import questions and Anki decks (CSV/TSV, APKG) and export to Markdown, JSON, Anki text, and PDF
Study with practice modes, timed exams, and adaptive flashcards with optional partial credit
Organize questions in a bank with tags, filters, editing, diagnostics, and reuse across quizzes
Connect AI providers (OpenAI, Gemini, Anthropic, Mistral, Cohere, Perplexity, Ollama) for question generation
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. AI generation sends note text to the configured provider and costs are controlled by the user's provider accounts; the plugin itself is free. Includes a privacy section (no telemetry, keychain storage of keys) and documented import/export limits (e.g., PDF export produces non-selectable text images).
intentEvidence: This independent implementation was inspired by Edward Cui's Quiz Generator.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn notes into quizzes or run structured study sessions with timers, grading, and question banks.

relations.evidence: This independent implementation was inspired by Edward Cui's Quiz Generator.

requires.name: API key for hosted AI providers (OpenAI, Gemini, Anthropic, Mistral, Cohere, Perplexity)

summary: Quiz study tool that generates quizzes from notes or imports them, then reviews them with practice, timed exams, and flashcards.
